articleTitle: Automatic Identification of Abnormalities in 12-Lead ECGs Using Expert Features and Convolutional Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Sensor Networks and Signal Processing (SNSP)
abstract: Automatic identification of the rhythm/morphology abnormalities in ECGs has gained growing attention in various areas and remains a challenge. We propose an algorithm to classify 12-lead ECGs into 9 categories. We extracted expert features including generic features and specific features with statistics and physiology significance. Then a 17-layer Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) was proposed to detect deep features in ECGs. With these features we trained ensemble classifiers to predict labels. Experiment on the training set (5-fold cross-validation) reports 0.81 accuracy score.

articleTitle: Research on Low Intercepting Radar Waveform Based on LFM and Barker Code Composite Modulation
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Sensor Networks and Signal Processing (SNSP)
abstract: Aiming at the problem that the single modulation radar signal is easily intercepted by the enemy in modern electronic countermeasures. A radar waveform based on LFM and Barker code compound modulation is designed from the radar emission waveform, using the characteristics of the LFM signal and the Barker code signal, and the composition of the low intercept radar waveform is theoretically analyzed. The time domain waveform, spectrum and ambiguity function diagram of the compound modulation signal are obtained by simulation. The distance of the compound modulation radar signal, the Doppler ambiguity function and the interception factor are studied by comparing with the LFM signal and the Barker code signal. The simulation results show that the waveform of the composite modulation radar has the strong low interception and anti-jamming ability due to the large time wide product of LFM signal and the Barker code signal. At the same time, it has better distance and speed resolution.

articleTitle: Short-Term Traffic Flow Prediction Based on Combination Model of Xgboost-Lightgbm
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Sensor Networks and Signal Processing (SNSP)
abstract: In modern intelligent transportation system, traffic control and traffic congestion management are main components of it. Real-time and accurate short-term traffic flow prediction is the precondition and key to realizing traffic control and traffic congestion management. In order to improve the accuracy of short-term traffic flow prediction, a combined model prediction method is proposed in this paper which is based on Xgboost and LightGBM algorithms. First, the short-term traffic flow data is preprocessed and features are sampled. Then, according to different characteristics, different prediction models are constructed by using Xgboost and LightGBM algorithms. Finally, these models are merged to generate the final model. Appling this model for prediction, the average travel time of the road can be obtained to predict the traffic flow and reflect road congestion. Experimental results show that the combined model has higher prediction accuracy than a single model, and it is an effective short-term traffic flow prediction method.

Author Keywords: Xgboost algorithms; LightGBM algorithms; combined model; short-term traffic flow prediction

articleTitle: Improved SDS-TWR Ranging Technology in UWB Positioning
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Sensor Networks and Signal Processing (SNSP)
abstract: In recent years, the UWB technology has become a hot spot for indoor location research because of its many advantages such as good penetration and strong anti-multipath capability. The distance measurement is the first step in positioning, so the accuracy of ranging directly affects the positioning accuracy. This article introduces several kinds of ranging technologies commonly used in wireless positioning. An improved SDS-TWR method is proposed for the clock drift problem in TOF technology. Through simulation experiments, the results show that the improved SDS-TWR method not only can reasonably use time resources, but also can effectively reduce the impact of clock drift and improve ranging accuracy in UWB positioning.

articleTitle: FPGA-Based IoT Sensor HUB
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Sensor Networks and Signal Processing (SNSP)
abstract: This paper mainly describes the sensor data acquisition interface system that is implemented by open source Microcontroller Unit (MCU) soft core transplantation based on FPGA and cooperating with the FPGA to implement the calculation module to achieve peripheral sensor management, data acquisition and interaction, which is able to be used for Internet of Things (IoT) sensor data acquisition. After the sensor collects the data, the preliminary data processing operation is completed by the calculation module instantiated by the FPGA, and then the result is returned to the MCU to realize the local storage of the final data and the Ethernet transmission. The system is designed on the basis of a Heterogeneous System Architecture (HSA) which is based on an open source soft core supplemented by a FPGA. This method achieves acceleration of data processing, with strong flexibility and high portability. It can replace various sensors for data interaction of the Internet of Things system.

articleTitle: A New Method for Collection and Annotation of Speech Data of Atypically Developing Children
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Sensor Networks and Signal Processing (SNSP)
abstract: The new database "AD-Child.Ru" includes 830 GB audio and video records of 153 children aged 4-16 years and 20 adults with atypical development. The database contains emotional speech and speech samples of children with five different types of psychiatric or neurological diagnosis: autism spectrum disorders, Down syndrome, mixed specific developmental disorders, mental retardation, cerebral palsy. Speech materials are collected in dialogue with the researcher, repetition of the words, play with the set of toys, picture description, retelling of the story, and book reading. Speech files are stored in Windows PCM format, 44100 Hz, 16 bits per sample. This database is designed to investigate the neurological and emotional state in the features of voice and speech of atypically developing children.

Author Keywords: speech database, atypically developing children, acoustic features

articleTitle: Heterogeneous Network Resource Allocation Optimization Based on Improved Bat Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Sensor Networks and Signal Processing (SNSP)
abstract: Femtocell networks can enhance indoor coverage and increase system capacity, but in the spectrum-shared Orthogonal Frequency Division Multiple Access (OFDMA) femtocell networks, peer-to-peer interference between femtocells and Cross-layer interference between femtocells and Macrocells severely limits system performance. For this kind of interference, a bat algorithm based on decreasing inertia weight is proposed. Taking the maximization of system throughput as the optimization goal, under the premise of satisfying the quality of service (Qos) of heterogeneous network users, the channel resource allocation of spectrum resources is performed using the improved bat algorithm, and the performance of the algorithm is compared with the genetic algorithm. Simulation results show that the number of sub-channels affects the network system capacity. Experiments show that in a heterogeneous network, the bat algorithm is used to allocate subchannels to improve the system capacity.

articleTitle: Bus-Crowdedness Estimation by Shallow Convolutional Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Sensor Networks and Signal Processing (SNSP)
abstract: Bus-crowdedness information is essential not only for a bus company to arrange schedules but also for passengers to plan their trip. This paper presents a very shallow Single camera based Convolutional Neural Networks (SCNN) and Multi-cameras based Convolutional Neural Networks (MCNN) to estimate the crowdedness of a bus. The images from front and back cameras are combined as input for the SCNN and MCNN models. To make the model robust enough, some strategies to generate samples are proposed, such as random cropped and random white balance. In order to minimize model, we try to reduce convolutional layers, reduce the size of convolution kennel and enlarge the stride of the max-pooling layer, instead of dropping the model. As such, the forward calculations of SCNN and MCNN are essentially reduced. The models are so lightweight that can run on an embedded system carried on the bus. Trace-based simulation demonstrate the viability of our design choices. Using the model to estimate the crowdedness level of the bus get a very high accuracy of 99.1%. It can be done in real time with high robustness.

articleTitle: Comparing the Different Seasonal CBERS 04 Images to Map the Quasi-Circular Vegetation Patches in the Yellow River Delta, China
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Sensor Networks and Signal Processing (SNSP)
abstract: This study compared five different seasonal CBERS-04 images for identifying the quasi-circular vegetation patches (QVPs) in the Yellow River Delta, China. Example-based feature extraction method in ENVI software 5.1 version, one of object-based image analysis, was adopted to segment the images based on edge algorithm, and K near neighbors method was used to identify the QVPs based on the training samples from visual interpretation with segmentation boundary. The research results from the present study showed that the seasonal impacts of multi-temporal CBERS-04 images for mapping the QVPs was important. The experimental results indicated that compared with other seasonal four images the higher precision rate, recall rate and F measure can be achieved by using the late spring season (May) image. Thus, it is significant to select proper seasonal images for monitoring the QVPs.

articleTitle: Design and Development of Forest Fire Monitoring Terminal
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Sensor Networks and Signal Processing (SNSP)
abstract: Forest fire causes serious harm, in order to achieve real-time monitoring of forest environment, this paper designs the forest environment monitoring system which consists of three parts, environmental data collection node, environmental monitoring terminal and environment data server.The forest environment data acquisition nodes expand their peripherals as environmental acquisition modules,such as wet temperature, smoke concentration, light intensity and flame, these collection nodes through ZigBee networks send the collected information to the environmental monitoring terminal;The environmental monitoring terminal using STM32 as the main controller, summary and processing analysis the data uploaded by the collection nodes, and then send the data to the remote server through the GPRS module;The server receives the environmental data uploaded by the environment monitoring terminal and through the data fusion algorithm uses the data collected by the sensors to output the three fire levels of the forest area.The results indicates that the forest fire monitoring system works stably which enables the collection of environmental data as well as the functions of remote sending and remote alarming.

articleTitle: A Summary of Traffic Identification Method Depended on Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Sensor Networks and Signal Processing (SNSP)
abstract: Traffic classification is an invaluable tool which can category network traffics into a number of traffic classes according to various parameter settings. It can not only provide better QoS, but also protect the security of networks. In this paper, the methods of traffic classification are analyzed and summarized based on machine learning through three aspects: supervised machine learning, unsupervised machine learning, and semi-supervised machine learning. Finally, we suggest several strategies to improve the accuracy and scalability of traffic classification.

Author Keywords: network traffic classification, machine learning, encryption traffic classification, network management

articleTitle: Multispectral Remote Sensing Land Use Classification Based on RBF Neural Network with Parameters Optimized by Genetic Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Sensor Networks and Signal Processing (SNSP)
abstract: In view of the problems existing in the application of multispectral image classification algorithms, such as low computational speed, low accuracy and difficult convergence, a multispectral remote sensing image classification method based on RBF neural network with parameters optimized by genetic algorithm (GA) is proposed in this paper. This model uses the multispectral sensing remote data and field measurement data of Dadukou District, Chongqing Municipality, to train and test a RBF neural network, and then uses GA to optimize the parameters of the RBF neural network. Then, multispectral sensing data classification is performed on the basis of the trained RBF neural network model. Moreover, the method is compared with the principal component analysis (PCA), linear discriminant analysis (LDA), RBF neural network, orthogonal matching pursuit (OMP) and support vector machine (SVM) algorithms. Experimental results indicate that the overall classification accuracy of this algorithm is improved about 11% compared to other algorithms, which enhances the accuracy of multispectral image classification effectively.

Author Keywords: Multispectral image; land use classification; genetic algorithm; RBF neural network; parameter optimized

articleTitle: An Improved Method for Measuring Grounding Resistance of Transport Tower
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Sensor Networks and Signal Processing (SNSP)
abstract: The grounding resistance of the transmission line tower is an important parameter to ensure the safe and stable operation of the power system. The accurate grasp of this parameter is the premise of formulating appropriate lightning protection measures for the power system. Since the periodic test task of the tower grounding resistance is heavy and half of the towers are located in the mountainous area, the conventional three-pole test method is difficult to carry out, so most of the tests are currently carried out by the clamp method. Generally, the high-voltage transmission line tower in operation senses the interference signal with amplitude variation on the grounding device. However, the caliper test instrument in the domestic market is weak in anti-interference, which results in large test error and cannot meet the requirements of on-site measurement. This paper presents an improved caliper type tower grounding resistance measurement method. The method is based on the principle of the clamp method, injects the adjustable frequency excitation voltage source, automatically switches the excitation source frequency through the self-check interference signal frequency band, avoids the interference signal frequency band, and obtains the response signal by loading the digital filtering module, and calculates the in-service Tower grounding resistance. The method has passed the test verification, which greatly saves human and financial resources, improves the accuracy value of the grounding resistance of the transport tower, and has a large application prospect.

articleTitle: Research on Image Enhancement Algorithm of Coal Mine Dust
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Sensor Networks and Signal Processing (SNSP)
abstract: For the foggy roadway in the coal mine, when the image were obtained by video there will exist many problems such as blur, low resolution and not obvious smoke contour caused by the reflection of coal dust and water vapor, which will affect the accuracy of video smoke detection. In this paper, a novel image enhancement method based on dark primary color prior and CLAHE algorithm has been presented. This algorithm uses one search method based on the quad-tree subdivision and according to the special condition of underground to seek atmospheric light, then combined with CLAHE algorithm to enhance the image. The experimental results show that the image obtained by this algorithm will suite for human vision and video smoke detection requirements better for its real, natural and clear smoke outline.

articleTitle: Road Targets Recognition Based on Deep Learning and Micro-Doppler Features
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Sensor Networks and Signal Processing (SNSP)
abstract: The ability of automotive millimeter-wave (MMW) radar to identify the road targets has a direct impact on the performance of Advanced Driver Assist System(ADAS). There are obvious differences in the Micro-Doppler features of the radar echo of pedestrians, automobiles and motorcycles. In this paper, a recognition method based on deep learning is proposed to realize the targets identification and classification by training and learning the Micro-Doppler features of the road targets. In this method, the time-frequency spectrogram of moving target echoes of the millimeter-wave radar is used as the training sample, convolutional neural network (CNN) is adopted to extract features and reduce dimension, and the output layer of the CNN is extended and fed into a recurrent neural networks (RNN) for sequence learning since the Micro-Doppler features of moving targets have obvious temporal correlation. The output layer of the network uses softmax regression to identify specific road targets. The Recognition results of measured data show that the proposed method has higher recognition accuracy and better recognition ability of road moving targets, compared with other machine learning methods that only use CNN.

Author Keywords: Road targets recognition, ADAS, Micro-Doppler feature, Deep learning, CNN, RNN

articleTitle: WIFI Security Certification through Device Information
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Sensor Networks and Signal Processing (SNSP)
abstract: With the rapid development of WIFI network technology, WIFI network has become one of the main ways to access the network. While wireless networks bring convenience, security issues have also attracted much attention. In this paper, a WIFI security authentication method for realizing device in-formation on the upper layer after connection authentication is proposed based on the underlying WIFI security parameters, through the analysis of WIFI security parameter configuration. Experiments verify that this authentication method can pre-vent illegal users from connecting to wireless hotspots, thus improving the security of networking through WIFI.

Author Keywords: Wireless network, WIFI, Parameter configuration, Connection authentication

articleTitle: High Gain Omnidirectional Dipole Array Antenna with Slot Coupler
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Sensor Networks and Signal Processing (SNSP)
abstract: A high gain omnidirectional dipole array antenna with slot coupler is proposed in this paper. The omnidirectional antenna is consisting of two pairs of dipoles and a feed line with impedance matching terminal. Slot couplers on the ground are excited by feedline to generate differential signals to feed dipoles respectively. Meanwhile, one pair of dipoles is placed with a distance λg to the other pair to ensure currents on dipoles in-phase. Dipoles and feedline are printed on the top layer of the substrate and ground with slots is etched on the other side. An antenna working in WiMAX 2.4 GHz band is designed. At the center frequency of 2.4 GHz, the simulated maximum gain is 4.3 dBi with vertical polarization and the gain is maintained within 3.4±0.9 dBi.

Author Keywords: omnidirectional antenna; high gain; WiMAX; vertical polarization

articleTitle: High Speed and High Precision Facial Recognition Using Log-Polar Transformation
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Sensor Networks and Signal Processing (SNSP)
abstract: Face recognition using log-polar transformation is possible to recognize faces without restricting the distance and rotation angle from face to camera. We proposed a face recognition method with fast log-polar transformation using only facial elements such as eyes and mouth [8]. This paper proposes a fast and highly accurate face recognition method which adds weighted image to the above method. Fast matching can be achieved by processing only a certain range from the center point of the face by using log-polar transformation. Furthermore, high-precision matching can be realized by weighting the characteristic parts of the face at the time of matching. In order to confirm the effectiveness of the proposed method, a face recognition experiment was conducted by 12 subjects. As a result, it was confirmed that faces can be recognized faster and with higher accuracy than conventional methods.

articleTitle: Research on Signal Denoising Method Based on Adaptive Lifting Wavelet Transform
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Sensor Networks and Signal Processing (SNSP)
abstract: In this paper, the adaptive lifting wavelet theory and its application in signal denoising are analyzed, and a signal processing method combining lifting wavelet transform and threshold denoising method is proposed. The lifting wavelet domain denoising method with different threshold functions is simulated by Matlab software. At the same time, the SNR and RMSE indicators are used to evaluate the effect of wavelet domain denoising. The simulation results show that the adaptive lifting wavelet combined with the semi-soft threshold denoising method preserves the advantages of the hard threshold and soft threshold methods in signal processing, and improves the signal-to-noise ratio while reducing the root mean square error, has a certain advantages in signal noise reduction processing.

articleTitle: The Application of CART Algorithm in Analyzing Relationship of MOOC Learning Behavior and Grades
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Sensor Networks and Signal Processing (SNSP)
abstract: Nowadays, with the coming of education informatization, MOOC is developing vigorously. Accumulating a large number of students' behavior data in the online teaching platforms has been widely concerned. In this paper, using the CART algorithm of decision tree, we analyze the data of MOOC about medical science in Stanford University. And then we explore the factors and importance influencing the test results. The study found that the total number of questions, the score of assignments, and the number of quizzes could be used as an important indicator of performance prediction. We also found that the decision tree model constructed by this course is as accurate as 90%, and the value of CART algorithm for online learning effect is tested. Finally, based on the related research of Stanford University, the paper puts forward some suggestions to improve the service mode of MOOC platforms.

articleTitle: Research on the IR-UWB Ranging Algorithm in Outdoor Near-Ground Environment
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Sensor Networks and Signal Processing (SNSP)
abstract: Impulse radio ultra-wideband (IR-UWB) has been adopted in wireless sensor networks (WSN) research due to its high precision ranging and localization capability. Focus on the outdoor near-ground environment, the propagation characteristics of the IR-UWB signal is researched experimentally. A time-of arrival (TOA) ranging algorithm is proposed. Based on the matched filter (MF) receiver, the searching steps of the direct path (DP) component in the dense multipath are discussed. The Kalman filter is also used to improve the performance of the ranging estimation. Experimental results show that the proposed algorithm is able to acquire accurate ranging results and well-suited for the WSN application in outdoor near-ground environment.

articleTitle: Design of Multi-service Network Slicing Scheme Based on SDN/NFV
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Sensor Networks and Signal Processing (SNSP)
abstract: With the rapid growth and diversification of communication services, the heavy network and the unreasonable distribution of resource have become an urgent problem. Most of the existing technical equipment lacks of versatility, has a single function and there is no mechanism for controlling network resources. A scheme of 5G network slicing technology based on SDN/NFV is presented. Using SDN centralized control theory, and NFV network virtualization theory, analyzing and researching the network pre-slice scheme based on multi-service and the traffic scheduling scheme based on network real-time situation. Among them, the network pre-slice scheme is studied, the result is transformed into queue information and deployed. The traffic scheduling scheme is studied from the perspective of the inter-slice and the intra-slice, and the result is converted into a stream table item and deployed. The SDN experimental platform was built, and the centralized control of the Open Flow protocol during resource control is verified by simulation. This paper completes the design of the multi-service network slicling scheme by redefining the virtualization of network environment and the redefinition of the software network.

articleTitle: Deep Video Foreground Target Extraction with Complex Scenes
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Sensor Networks and Signal Processing (SNSP)
abstract: The foreground extraction of video is derived from frame difference and background subtraction. These methods have always relied on the temporal consistency of successive video frames. If the video consistency is suddenly destroyed, such as an object being occluded, some frames are lost, or the camera is shaken, etc., the results of foreground extraction may be significantly degraded. In this paper, our extends One-Shot Video Object Segmentation by adding two branchs for Positioning foreground targets and propagating foreground semantic information. These two branches are parallel to the existing foreground segmentation branches, which facilitates efficient iterative and fine-tuning of the foreground segmentation branches. This foreground extraction method is different from the previous background subtraction and frame difference methods. Our method does not rely on the time information and only needs to give the manual annotation of one frame, which can extract all the specific foreground in the video sequence. Then, the coloring can get complete foreground information for the separated target. Experiments show that the foreground extraction algorithm applied in this paper has better robustness in dynamic background, camera shake, intermittent motion of objects, low contrast, and so on.

articleTitle: Test Method for the Safety Performance of the Millimeter Wave Radar -Based Autonomous Vehicle Using Distance Deception Jamming
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Sensor Networks and Signal Processing (SNSP)
abstract: To evaluate the safety performance of the millimeter-wave (MMW) radar-based autonomous vehicle effectively, we present a novel test method using distance deception jamming. The working principle of this method is described systematically. A signal generator device is developed to generate a deceptive signal contains false distance information. The related parameters of the experimental setup are calculated and configured reasonably. The experimental results show that the proposed method can meet the requirement of the safety performance evaluation for the autonomous vehicle based on MMW radar, and it is superior to previous methods.

articleTitle: Research and Improvement of Current Hysteresis Control Strategy for Boost DC-DC Converter
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Sensor Networks and Signal Processing (SNSP)
abstract: Aiming to shorten the transient recovery time of Boost DC-DC converter, a novel design of transient control strategy is proposed based on the current hysteresis control strategy. According to the jump of the output load, it can be judged whether the output current is suddenly increasing or dropping. If the load current suddenly increases, the current surge transient control strategy is started. If the load current suddenly drops, the current dip transient control strategy is started. If no sudden change occurs, the current hysteresis steady state control strategy is followed. Under appropriate parameter settings, the simulation results show that the designed transient control strategy can maintain the output voltage fluctuation amplitude and effectively shorten the transient recovery process under the condition of load jump, improve the stability of the output voltage.

articleTitle: Application of Logistic Regression in WEB Vulnerability Scanning
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Sensor Networks and Signal Processing (SNSP)
abstract: In the anomaly detection case of the web site, the traditional vulnerability scanning technology is com-monly used for active defense at present, but there are some problems such as incomplete data crawling and time consuming iteration of rule set, Therefore, this paper puts forward a logistic regression model based on machine learning to detect anomaly of web traffic, using TF-IDF algorithm to complete the feature extraction of URL, then training the logistic regression model, it is found that using LBFGS algorithm can be used as a loss function to obtain better model accuracy. At the same time, the experimental results show that the model can distinguish abnormal traffic well for newly generated web traffic.

Author Keywords: logistic regression, web vulnerability Scanning, machine learning, loss function, TF-IDF

articleTitle: Application of Multilink Aggregation and Load Balancing in Wireless Real-Time Video Transmission System
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Sensor Networks and Signal Processing (SNSP)
abstract: With the development of technology, real-time video services have been widely used. However, the current wireless communication technology has insufficient transmission capability to meet the real-time transmission of high-definition video in all situations, which limits the development of the service. To solve this problem, multi-link aggregation technology can be used in the 4G mobile deployment control system to increase bandwidth through link aggregation, and use rate control and load balancing processing to improve the realtime video transmission rate and quality.

Author Keywords: multi-link aggregation; real-time video transmission; transmission rate control; weighted polling dynamic equilibrium

articleTitle: A Hardware Implementation of SOM Neural Network Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Sensor Networks and Signal Processing (SNSP)
abstract: Aiming at the real-time problem of SOM(Self-Organizing Feature Map) neural network algorithm based on FPGA(Field Programmable Gate Array), this paper analyzes the parallelism and resource reuse of algorithm process, presents a parallel architecture to implement the algorithm, and gives the hardware design method of the key modules in the architecture. It is simulated by Modelsim and runs on the FPGA development board. The experimental results show that the architecture can ensure the performance of neural network and the circuit has a high processing speed.

articleTitle: A Convolutional Neural Network for Identifying Premature Ventricular Contraction Beat and Right Bundle Branch Block Beat
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Sensor Networks and Signal Processing (SNSP)
abstract: Classification of electrocardiograms (ECG) signals is obligatory for the automatic diagnosis of cardiovascular disease (CVD). Currently, there are a lot of machine learning methods which can be utilized for analyzing and classifying the ECG beats. However, the foremost shortcomings of these traditional machine learning solutions are use of a shallow structured classifier and hand-crafted suitable features. In this paper, we propose a nine-layer convolutional neural network (CNN) that can automatically extract appropriate features and detect the different categories of ECG beats based on individual records. Ten-fold cross-validation strategy is designed that boosts the robustness of our proposed CNN model. Our dataset consists of three types of ECG beats, namely: normal beat (N), premature ventricular contraction beat (V), and right bundle branch block beat (R). The experimental results demonstrate that with an appropriate choice of structure and parameters, our proposed deep learning model can classify the ECG hearts with a diagnose sensitivity of 98.37%, specificity of 99.19%, and accuracy of 98.92%. This proposed algorithm model can serve as an auxiliary tool to assist the clinicians for their diagnosis.

Author Keywords: Cardiovascular disease (CVD), Electrocardiograms (ECG), Convolutional neural network (CNN), Classification.

articleTitle: A New Visible and Infrared Image Fusion Algorithm Based on NSCT
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Sensor Networks and Signal Processing (SNSP)
abstract: This paper propose an image fusion algorithm for infrared (IR) and visual (VIS) image. The proposed method firstly decompose input images into low and high frequency sub-bands using Non-Subsampled Contourlet Transform (NSCT). Secondly, an adaptive weighted fusion rule is developed to fuse the low frequency sub-band of input image. The proposed fusion rule generate weight map using Gaussian function in low frequency sub-band. To highlight the high frequency feature, the high frequency sub-bands is fused by the max absolute rule. Finally, the fused image is generated using the fused sub-band images by the inverse NSCT. The experiments show that the proposed method provides improved subjective visual and objective evaluation results compared with GFL and average fusion rules.

articleTitle: An Efficient Authentication Scheme for Privacy-Preserving in Secure Vehicular Communications
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Sensor Networks and Signal Processing (SNSP)
abstract: VANETs can significantly improve traffic management and driving safety. It has attracted great attention of government departments, academia and industry circles. To perform cooperative operations, vehicles should broadcast traffic information to RSUs and other vehicles periodically. Unfortunately, the massive messages should be digitally signed and verified in a very short time to the real-time constraints. To deal with this issue, we propose an efficient anonymous authentication scheme, in which RSU becomes the message center that can establish the session relationship with the surrounding vehicles and assign temporary identities to vehicles. Using the temporary identity and session key, every vehicle is only responsible for transmitting messages to RSU, the latter for collecting and validating messages from vehicles and broadcasting the information verified. To obtain traffic information, any vehicle only need verify the broadcast messages from RSU. In addition, the proposed scheme can provide anonymity in the RSU's coverage. The security and performance analysis illustrates that the proposed scheme can effectively protect the user's security and can provide fast authentication.

articleTitle: High Dynamic Spread Spectrum Signal Acquisition Algorithm based on Delay Autocorrelation
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Sensor Networks and Signal Processing (SNSP)
abstract: A carrier acquisition algorithm based on delay autocorrelation is proposed due to the failure of applying traditional fast Fourier transform (FFT)-based carrier acquisition method to high-dynamic spread spectrum signal acquisition with large Doppler frequency shift and large change rate. Firstly, two parameters are considered, i.e. highdynamic Doppler initial frequency shift and frequency change rate. Then, the modulation of the high-dynamic spread spectrum receiving signal by square method as well as the influence of spread spectrum code was removed. After that, the Intermediate Frequency (IF) sampling signal is correlated with its delay, and the estimations of Doppler frequency shift and its initial shift are obtained by applying the delay autocorrelation FFT on the signal to complete the compensation. The simulation results show that the proposed algorithm can not only shorten the capture time, reduce the computational cost, but also quickly complete the estimation of initial carrier Doppler frequency and its change rate. The proposed algorithm satisfies the conditions of large Doppler frequency shift and fast acquisition.

Author Keywords: high dynamic; spread spectrum signal; delay autocorrelation; Doppler frequency shift

articleTitle: Prediction of Livestock Diseases Using Ontology
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Sensor Networks and Signal Processing (SNSP)
abstract: In this study, calves were selected as part of livestock disease management. The evaluation of the calf disease was based on the history of calf birth, measurement of calf biometrics, environmental details of the house, and information on infections and immunity status for disease management. These diseases occur at an appropriate level of immune status and are often accompanied by diarrhea as a clinical symptom. Calf diarrhea results in death. The findings of this study indicated the necessity for livestock breeding farms to report the birth of calves and attach ears to the livestock so as to enable the environmental management of livestock.

articleTitle: Ontology Pattern of Trajectory Anonymity for Query Events
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Sensor Networks and Signal Processing (SNSP)
abstract: Focused on the issue that most of existing anonymization scheme for trajectory cannot prevent attacks by background knowledge of queries, a novel ontology pattern of trajectory anonymity for query events was proposed that using the advantage of event ontology. Firstly, the data of identity privacy, geography information and sensitive query events was formulated by OWL, and a trajectory anonymity query pattern based on event ontology was established. Then all the query events in ontology were clustered into anonymized sets according to structural similarity and Jena reasoning engine, an inference service of query events for trajectory data was presented. Finally, the experimental results show that, our pattern can decrease the information loss by 5% to 15% in anonymity, while the query precision maintain on 65%. The proposed method can maintain the availability of trajectory during anonymity that triggered by ontology pattern.

Author Keywords: trajectory anonymity; query attack events; ontology pattern; anonymity clustering

articleTitle: Cloud Feature Extraction and Classification of Meteorological Satellite Cloud Imagery
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Sensor Networks and Signal Processing (SNSP)
abstract: At present, meteorologists mainly adopt manual interpretation methods through satellite cloud imagery which are subjective and inefficient for weather analysis. Some researchers have proposed that computers can automatically classify cloud images by extracting the spectral features, texture features, spatial features, etc. However, the existing feature extraction and classification algorithms have problems of low precision, large computational complexity, and poor practicability. In this paper, the gray-scale co-occurrence matrix and the Gabor wavelet algorithms are proposed to extract the texture features of the three kinds of cloud images: cirrus cloud, cumuliform cloud and stratiform cloud, combined with the support vector machine classifier to classify cloud images. The results show that the approaches proposed in this paper can achieve more than 90% classification accuracy for the above three kinds of cloud images in a reliable manner.

articleTitle: When Machine Learning Boosts Sensing Performance: A Compact and Contactless Soil Moisture Sensor Example
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Sensor Networks and Signal Processing (SNSP)
abstract: Nowadays, even if the “machine learning” term has degenerated into a buzz-word, it encloses a large framework of techniques that has recently demonstrated a disruptive change of the performance in a large number of application, thanks to the increased amount of data and novel approaches to treat them. Some parts of these framework (such as multivariate analysis) have been known since a long time, however they have been rediscovered and improved thanks to this new application trend. In this paper we will show how the extraction of the information in sensing could be dramatically improved on the basis of multivariate analysis techniques. We demonstrate the capabilities in a novel compact implementation of a soil moisture sensor based on a contactless microwave impedance spectroscopy technique.

Author Keywords: component: multivariate analysis; impedance spectroscopy; microwave; soil moisture sensor

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of F-OFDM Downstream Filter
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Sensor Networks and Signal Processing (SNSP)
abstract: In this paper, the F-OFDM downstream filter is designed, and the design principle and parameter considerations of the subband filter are obtained through simulation. First of all, by analyzing the framework of F-OFDM system, the difference between the OFDM and its structure is compared, and the main difference between them is that the subband filter module is added in F-OFDM. Secondly, the filter adopts the window function design method. By analyzing and comparing the filtering characteristics of several common window functions, the Hanning window is selected as the window function of the filter. Finally, the research focuses on the analysis of the subband modulation and the number of protected sub-carriers on the system power spectral density. Simulation results show that subband filtering can effectively suppress the out-of-band spectral leakage, and by setting appropriate subband protection intervals, each sub-band can be clearly distinguished to reduce the interference between subbands.

articleTitle: Impact of EVM on Network Performance
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Sensor Networks and Signal Processing (SNSP)
abstract: The error vector magnitude (EVM) is a key metric of the quality of digital modulation in modern wireless communication systems, Based on the requirement of LTE transmitter test standard for EVM, this paper first analyzes the network performance of the single-antenna two-antenna antenna under two conditions of EVM5% and EVM8% deterioration under the Orthogonal Frequency Division Multiplexing (OFDM). Firstly, the impact of channel quality indicator(CQI) prediction error on system throughput is evaluated emphatically; Secondly, we study the effect of different EVM on bit error rate, block error rate and frame error rate of 64QAM at different rates under the EVM allowed when the peak rate is reached.And this paper redicts EVM standards for higher order modulation.

articleTitle: Research on Clustering Analysis of New Energy Charging User Behavior Based on Spark
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Sensor Networks and Signal Processing (SNSP)
abstract: This paper utilizes the user charging behavior data accumulated in the new energy charging operation management system.By using the entropy weight method, a charging user value evaluation index system is established based on the current market value and potential market value of the charging user.And from these two dimensions, the clustering analysis was performed, and the behavior analysis model of charging user based on k-means algorithm was constructed on the spark platform.The reliability and validity of the model are verified by an example.And this model can quickly analyzing the data to obtain useful information to help power supply enterprises to provide differentiated marketing services for different types of users.

articleTitle: Multi-feature Image Retrieval Algorithm Based on Block Color Weighting
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Sensor Networks and Signal Processing (SNSP)
abstract: Aiming at the defects of traditional color histogram algorithm, this paper proposes a new weighted color histogram extraction algorithm. First, the image is processed as a block and according to the number of significant points in each block for the given weight, And then extract the color histogram features of each block separately, so as to obtain the color feature after image block weighting; While extracting images of Tamura texture, the color and texture of the two features together. Finally, the degree of similarity is reflected by the distance between the image feature vectors. The experimental results show that the proposed algorithm can effectively increase the spatial distribution characteristics when extracting eigenvectors, and achieve a better retrieve results.

articleTitle: A New Wireless Mesh Network Based on Network Coding Technology
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Sensor Networks and Signal Processing (SNSP)
abstract: Aiming at the issues of information sensing, transmission, analysis, feedback control and information exchange in metropolitan area networks, a new wireless mesh transmission network based on network coding technology is designed in this paper. The network nodes store, forward and process the received data with transmission characteristics of the wireless channel, and optimize inter-message client communication. By analyzing the connection mode of relay nodes and the multi-source information coding, a multicast relay network coding algorithm and a multi-source random network coding algorithm are proposed. The test results indicate that the bandwidth of 54Mbps can reach 49.3Mbps after 3-hop transmission, and can still reach 10.43Mbps through 24-hop, the packet loss rate of 220GB within 10s is as low as 0.19%, which solves the problem of multi-hop transmission bandwidth utilization and effective transmission of massive data.

articleTitle: Application of IPv6 in Coal Mine Safety Production Monitoring
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Sensor Networks and Signal Processing (SNSP)
abstract: The rise of internet and internet of things technology has brought new opportunities for the construction of smart mines. This paper proposes a new type of coal mine safety production monitoring system based on IPv6 network transmission, aiming at the problems such as the transmission distance and the small system capacity encountered in the existing coal mine safety production monitoring system based on bus transmission. IPv6, as the core technology adopted by the next-generation Internet, will be applied to the transmission of coal mine safety monitoring systems, which can effectively realize underground coal mine safety production monitoring and solve the problems encountered in bus transmission. This paper proposes a coal mine safety production monitoring system based on IPv6 network transmission. The system adopts 6LoWPAN protocol, which mainly includes three parts: sensor, transmission network and client.

articleTitle: Compensation Algorithm of MEMS Heading Sensor on Small UAV
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Sensor Networks and Signal Processing (SNSP)
abstract: According to installation position of heading sensor on UAV, introducing two kinds of heading compensation algorithm. One is improved Honeywell compensation algorithm when heading sensor installed level, the other is improved ellipsoid fitting compensation algorithm when heading sensor didn't install level. According to these two compensation algorithms, this article progressed ground static compensation experiment and flight experiment. According to the output data of heading sensor which compared with high precision inertial guidance data, validated these two different compensation algorithms for different installation position of heading sensor can also realize the high accuracy heading compensations.

Author Keywords: Improved Honeywell compensation algorithm, improved ellipsoid fitting compensation algorithm, heading sensor, high precision compensation

articleTitle: Multi-view Gait Recognition Method Based on Dynamic and Static Feature Fusion
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Sensor Networks and Signal Processing (SNSP)
abstract: In view of the complexity of gait recognition and the unsatisfactory recognition effect in different states, a new method of gait recognition based on dynamic and static features fusion is proposed. In order to retain as many gait characteristics as possible, the gait energy graph is chosen as the static feature, stride and step frequency as dynamic features, and feature fusion is carried out. A method of kernel principal component analysis combined with local preserving projection to reduce dimension of gait feature (KPCA-LPP) is proposed. Aiming at the problem of low recognition rate in non-regular perspective and multiple-view recognition, the paper improves the multi-view gait network, and uses the fast decomposition orthogonal matching tracking algorithm based on kernel function to classify and identify. The simulation results show that the proposed algorithm has some advantages over the existing classical algorithms, good recognition rate, the recognition effect is not affected by the interference factors such as backpack and overcoat, and the robustness is better.

articleTitle: A Monitoring System for Crack Growth Rate Based on Direct Current Potential Drop
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Sensor Networks and Signal Processing (SNSP)
abstract: Monitoring systems of stress corrosion crack (SCC) growth rate of nuclear power structure materials has had many problems like monitoring difficulties and cost, etc. Taking into account these problems, a monitoring system for stress corrosion crack (SCC) growth rate based on direct current potential drop (DCPD) technology has been developed. The principle and details of the DCPD in monitoring the materials crack growth are introduced. The calibration relationship between the potential drop and the crack growth length is obtained by numerical simulation. The Crack growth length can be obtained by the real-time monitoring of potential data. As per demand, the system can communicate successfully with the instrument, and realize the functions of instruments like parameter setting, data acquisition and processing of the instrument parameters in the monitoring. The potential of the standard Crack Tip(CT) sample has been tested using this system. The results show that every function runs successfully, the characteristics of the monitored potential signal are consistent with theoretical expectations, and can meet the monitoring requirements of the potential drop signal effectively.

articleTitle: Design of the CMOS Switching Hall Sensor Circuit
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Sensor Networks and Signal Processing (SNSP)
abstract: In this paper, a switch-mode CMOS Hall sensor circuit is designed, which used the quadrature current method and chopper stabilization technique to eliminate the offset voltage from the Hall component and the amplifier. At the same time, the chopper amplifier can be used to amplify the effective Hall signal. Finally, the modulation-demodulation method is used to eliminate the offset voltage from the Hall component and the amplifier. Using a 0.18μ CMOS process model in Cadence simulation environment, the simulation results show that the sensor can effectively eliminate 10mV offset voltage from the Hall component and the amplifier. The final output of hall voltage with 0, 1 level.

articleTitle: Big Data Compression and Storage for Continuous Spatio-Temporal Monitoring of Power Transmission Cables with Distributed Fiber-Optic Vibration Sensor (DFOVS)
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Sensor Networks and Signal Processing (SNSP)
abstract: In this paper, an effective real-time compression method is proposed to compress the tremendous amount of data generated in continuous spatio-temporal monitoring of power transmission cables with the distributed fiber-optic vibration sensor(DFOVS). The proposed method mainly consists of anomaly detection by statistical methods and Lifting Wavelet Transform(LWT) with an adaptive OTSU threshold. The experiment results for real field data indicate that the average compression ratio of this method can reach 138.9. Therefore the proposed method can effectively solve the challenging problems of real-time storage and transmission for big data acquired from a high density spatio-temporal acquisition grid. Besides, LWT has a higher calculation efficiency than the conventional Discrete Wavelet Transform (DWT) in real applications. And the data storage time can be obviously saved by using the proposed method on the big data processing platform of HDFS and HBase. The overall compression time is generally less than the massive data generation time in long distance or large range monitoring with DFOVS, thus it can be used for real-time compression of similar applications with moderate sampling rate.

articleTitle: EIRP Measurement and Error Analysis of 5G Base Station
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Sensor Networks and Signal Processing (SNSP)
abstract: In this paper, two methods namely far-field absolute method and far-field relative method for measuring effective isotropic radiated power (EIRP) of fifth generation (5G) base station (BS) are analyzed and compared. According to the analysis of basic principle, measuring complexity and measuring results, we draw a conclusion that the relative method has higher test accuracy. From the perspective of the theory and the actual test, each error term is analyzed in detail by using the relative method measuring EIRP with the existing chamber facilities. Finally, a case of EIRP measurement for 5G BS of Ka-wavelength is given which shows that the test results agree with the theoretical calculation results.

articleTitle: Research on Brake Control of Switched Reluctance Motor
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Sensor Networks and Signal Processing (SNSP)
abstract: This paper analyzes the theory and method of regenerative braking control of switched reluctance motor, firstly, the accurate detection and overcurrent phenomenon of switched reluctance motor are studied in detail, secondly, the regenerative braking strategy of single-phase and two-phase operation is established. Based on the voltage PWM chopper control scheme, a control method for changing the duty cycle of the brake phase voltage is proposed.Finally, a 3kW three-phase switched reluctance motor with rated speed of 1500r/min is the experimental object, The feasibility and reliability of the regenerative braking strategy and the effectiveness of the control method for changing the braking phase voltage duty cycle are verified.Theory and practice show that, these are important for improving the control performance of the switched reluctance motor and optimizing system protection.

articleTitle: A Board Omnidirectional Coplanar Waveguide Antenna with Choke Sleeve
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Sensor Networks and Signal Processing (SNSP)
abstract: A board omnidirectional coplanar waveguide (CPW) antenna is designed with a choke sleeve in this paper to realize high gain and good radiation performances. The antenna employs four λg/2 long units which are staggerconnected to achieve in-phase current on each unit. In this way, a high gain omnidirectional antenna can be obtained. By loading the designed choke sleeve which is aimed at reducing surface current on the coaxial feeder outer conductor and an additional infinite ground, this board antenna performance would not be affected by an even longer coaxial line. The simulation results show that the operating frequency with reflection coefficient less than -10 dB ranges from 5.71 GHz to 6.05 GHz. The maximum gain at the center frequency of 5.8GHz in the boresight is 5.3 dBi. The out-of-roundness of the omnidirectional radiation pattern in the azimuthal plane (XOY plane) is less than 1.3 dBi. Also, the reflection coefficient, gain and radiation patterns are showed with and without choke sleeve for comparison. Radiation patterns could be improved by the added choke sleeve. The proposed antenna with simple configuration, low profile, compactness and low fabrication cost becomes a candidate as a board antenna for WiMAX applications.

articleTitle: Object Detection in Aerial Images Based on Cascaded CNN
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Sensor Networks and Signal Processing (SNSP)
abstract: Object detection in aerial images is widely used for military applications, such as reconnaissance, target surveillance, battle damage assessment, et al. However, the tasks are very challenging due to a lot of factors, such as illumination variance, scene complexity, and platform motion. To deal with these problems, a new cascaded convolutional neural network (CNN) model for object detection from airborne videos is proposed. The proposed framework adopts a cascaded structure with three levels of deep CNNs that predict objects in a coarse-to-fine manner. The experimental results showed that the proposed method can achieve better performance.

Author Keywords: object detection; cascaded convolutional neural network; aerial image

articleTitle: Geometric Calibration of Distributed Microphone Arrays Based on Cross-Correlation Function
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Sensor Networks and Signal Processing (SNSP)
abstract: In this paper, we provide a solution to achieve the robustness of geometric calibration of distributed microphone arrays, under the condition that each microphone array has a non-ideal knowledge of the position of the microphones. We consider two microphone arrays located in arbitrary positions and propose a robust algorithm for sound source mapping based on cross-correlation function by placing a sound source in N different positions in the visual range of the two microphone arrays. An estimation is provided also on the rotation matrix R and translation vector t, which can represent the position and direction between two microphone arrays, using the techniques of Computer Vision. Experimental results demonstrate that the calibration algorithm based on cross-correlation function still performs well even in presence of a high microphone position error.

articleTitle: Wireless Body Area Network Identity Authentication Protocol Based on Physical Unclonable Function
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Sensor Networks and Signal Processing (SNSP)
abstract: Aiming at the malicious attacks caused from the sensor identity authentication in wireless body area networks (WBAN), the sensor cannot transmit information normally and even cause the life-threatening problem. In this paper, the physical unclonable function module is added to the sensor of the wireless body area networks, and an energy-saving, real-time sensor authentication protocol is proposed. The energy consumption of the authentication protocol based on the physical unclonable function is studied by analyzing the energy consumption of the authentication based on the public key cryptosystem and the physical unclonable function of the IOT device. The simulation results show that the authentication protocol can reduce the energy consumption of authentication when the networks security is satisfied.

articleTitle: Research on Streaming Media Adaptive Congestion Control Technology
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Sensor Networks and Signal Processing (SNSP)
abstract: At present, streaming media technology has been widely used in the field of interaction. However, due to factors such as network bandwidth, data loss occurs during data transmission, which affects the quality of interaction between people. Therefore, it is very important to adaptively adjust the data transmission rate so as to reduce the packet loss rate during transmission. According to the requirements of data transmission process, the detection-based congestion control algorithm and the model-based congestion control algorithm are analyzed, and the AIMD algorithm in the detection algorithm and the RCC algorithm in the model algorithm are compared. And to improve the AIMD algorithm, in addition to the memory function of the AIMD algorithm, it also tentatively breaks the current memory in some special circumstances, thereby improving the utilization of the bandwidth and the smoothness of the data transmission, real-time, and ensure the interaction quality.

articleTitle: Bird Damage Detection System Based on High Voltage Line
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Sensor Networks and Signal Processing (SNSP)
abstract: In response to bird damage, this paper uses dynamic video target detection technology to develop a set of intelligent detection devices for high-voltage transmission lines. Firstly, the optimized motion history map (MHI) is used to extract the foreground information of the moving target, and then the detection algorithm is transplanted into the embedded chip Hi3531, and the control signal is sent to the windows working platform while the display screen detects the bird. Through the analysis of the experimental results of different acquisition videos, it is concluded that the bird damage can be detected and the monitoring results can be displayed in time while the bird occurs.

articleTitle: Performance Improvement of Symbol Decision for Visual-MIMO System in RGB LED Lighting
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Sensor Networks and Signal Processing (SNSP)
abstract: In this paper, we propose a representative color selection method by removing saturated white color to improve symbol color decision performance of the color-independent visual-MIMO system in lighting using RGB LEDs. We apply k-means clustering to represent all pixels as a set of colors and remove the color clusters located around the standard illuminant E by using the standard deviation of the set of colors. The average of the rest of the set of colors determines the symbol color. We demonstrate that the proposed method improves symbol decision accuracy than the conventional average method in RGB LED lighting.

articleTitle: LCC Compensation Analysis of Loosely Coupled Power Transmission Based on Class-E Power Amplifier
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Sensor Networks and Signal Processing (SNSP)
abstract: In order to reduce the effect of the loosely coupled transformer on the wireless power transfer system and achieve maximum power transmission of the system, the LCC compensated inductively coupled power transfer system based on the class-E inverter is proposed. According to the fundamental characteristics of the class-E amplifier and the LCC circuit, combined with the soft-switching operating conditions, the formula for calculating parameters of LCC compensation circuit is derived. By applying the constraint to the resistive component of the primary coil input impedance and the coupling coefficient, the optimum parameter value can be selected to ensure the system efficiency. Finally, the parameters simulation are supplied to verify the system transfer efficiency and load-carrying capacity. It shows that the zero-voltage turn off of the high-frequency inverter is realized and the overall ICPT system efficiency is improved.

articleTitle: The Design and Implementation of Tracking BeiDou High Sensitivity Acquisition Method
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Sensor Networks and Signal Processing (SNSP)
abstract: With the rapid and efficient development of BeiDou navigation system, the high-sensitivity signal capture chip based on Soc (system on Chip) architecture has gradually become the industry research and development mainstream and benchmark. Thus, how to design and implement the weak BOC-modulated BDS signal acquisition and tracking process has already been a research hotspot and difficulty. To meet the satellite signal RF module demand of high dynamic, high precision and high sensitivity performance, the technical architecture has been designed for fast, accurate and effective capture of the two-dimensional, weak and no-fuzzy BDS navigation signal trapped fundamental issue, which can significantly resolve and enhance the tough problems in traditional BPSK-modulated BDS signal acquisition and tracking process. Finally, scenario was tested in real-time weak signal scene which are provided by Spirent signal simulator. The results indicate the proposed design and implementation can correctly collect and track the weak BPSK-modulated BDS weak navigation signal. The accurate parameters such as user's location, velocity and PDOP can be provided to users with accurate precision and high sensitivity.

articleTitle: Image Enhancement Algorithm in Solar Cells with Improved Bi-Histogram Equalization
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Sensor Networks and Signal Processing (SNSP)
abstract: As a new energy material, solar cells are difficult to study for the non-destructive testing of their quality. The gray value of the damaged area and the undamaged area of the infrared image of the solar cell obtained by the infrared technology is relatively small, which brings great difficulties to the detection of the solar cell. In order to improve the quality of infrared images of solar cells, a bi-histogram equalization image enhancement algorithm with an influence factor is proposed in this paper. Experiments were conducted using standard images and solar cell infrared images, and compared with the conventional bi-histogram equalization enhancement algorithm. The simulation results showed that under the same image information and contrast evaluation indexes, the algorithm in this paper obtained a larger signal-to-noise ratio.

Author Keywords: image enhancement; bi-histogram equalization; segmentation threshold

articleTitle: Audio Amplitude-Level Quantification Vector for Identification of Audio Post-Processing Operation
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Sensor Networks and Signal Processing (SNSP)
abstract: Audio tampering is typically followed by post-processing operations to mask the artifacts potentially perceptible by human ears and blur the traces of tampering. However, research on the issue of audio post-processing identification is still a blanket. This paper mainly introduces a method to identify audio post-processing operations. A new audio feature - Audio Amplitude-Level Quantification Vector (AQV) is proposed, then the probability distributions of AQV of audio are calculated and extracted as audio features which are then used for identification of various audio processing. During the detection, the K-Nearest Neighbors (KNN) classifier is applied for classification. Experimental results show that the proposed AQV method can not only verify the authenticity of the speech audio, but also have a significant effect on identifying different types of post-processing operations.

articleTitle: Bidirectional Pedestrian Counting Based on Virtual Gate Tracking
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Sensor Networks and Signal Processing (SNSP)
abstract: A method for bidirectional pedestrian counting at entrance and exit of passageways in intelligent video surveillance was proposed. First of all, we detect the pedestrian targets, then set the ROI(region of interest) region and bidirectional counting line as virtual gate. According to the feature information of the detected moving targets that through the virtual gate, the targets are divided into single pedestrian and multiple pedestrians. In this paper, we only track the pedestrian targets that enter the virtual gate area and establish the corresponding tracking array, then use the motion parameters in the target tracking array to perform bidirectional counting.The experimental results show that the method can achieve good effect and real-time performance in the pedestrian counting at the entrance and exit of the passageways.

Author Keywords: target detection, virtual gate, target tracking, bidirectional counter

articleTitle: A New Algorithm to Reduce PAPR in OFDM System
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Sensor Networks and Signal Processing (SNSP)
abstract: This paper analyzes the reason, why Peak-to-average power ratio (PAPR) is too high in Orthogonal Frequency Division Multiplexing (OFDM) system and the impairment of PAPR to communication quality. Then, this paper proposes a new differential regression algorithm to reduce PAPR. By differentiating the frequency domain signal so that the average power of the regression signal equals the average power of the original signal, the variance of the instantaneous power becomes smaller. Use this method of reducing the probability of occurrence of large-value instantaneous power to achieve peak-to-average power ratio suppression. Compared with the pulse cancellation algorithm and the tone reservation algorithm (TR), the differential regression method has lower complexity and higher peak clipping performance.

articleTitle: Application of Fuzzy Algorithms Based on Neural Networks to the Hybrid Energy Management Systems of Future Combat Vehicles
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Sensor Networks and Signal Processing (SNSP)
abstract: Future combat vehicles will implement hybrid energy management systems comprised of complex multivariable non-linear algorithms. In this paper, fuzzy algorithms based on neural networks (NNs) were applied to a hybrid energy management system. In addition, a combination of fuzzy theory and NN computing theory was analyzed in detail. Fuzzy control algorithms were also used to resolve the run mode switch and power distribution issues of energy management systems. Furthermore, the proposed energy management control strategy was validated using MATLAB. The results of the simulation indicated that the proposed control strategy and algorithms could improve the working conditions and adaptability of future combat vehicles.

Author Keywords: Hybrid energy management, fuzzy algorithms, neural networks, simulation

articleTitle: Design of Network Camera Based on ONVIF in the Dark Environment
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Sensor Networks and Signal Processing (SNSP)
abstract: This paper introduces a design scheme of a Mine Network camera based on Open Network Video Interface Forum (ONVIF). The device adopts Cortex-A8 processor as the central control unit, adopts infrared laser as auxiliary illumination unit, adopts CMOS Charge-coupled Device (MCCD) image sensor as acquisition unit and adopts power supply adaptation scheme of intrinsically safe circuit technology to obtain video collection function in all black environment. It compresses, stores, and transmits captured video images. It overcomes the shortcomings of unclear collection of dark environment in the existing products and serious red storms. It supports Transmission Control Protocol/Internet Protocol (TCP/IP), User Datagram Protocol (UDP) and ONVIF protocols, and realizes seamless connection with common clients on the market. After testing, the visual distance of the dark environment is 50 meters. Through the network, the monitoring information can be obtained in real time on the client supporting ONVIF, and the high-definition video collection can be realized in the dark environment under the mine.

Author Keywords: ONVIF, video capture, intrinsic security, dark environment, Cortex-A8

articleTitle: Deep Chinese Word Sense Disambiguation Method Based on Sequence to Sequence
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Sensor Networks and Signal Processing (SNSP)
abstract: In the field of natural language processing, word sense disambiguation plays an important role. The word sense disambiguation method based on traditional machine learning is not high in accuracy, and it is necessary to extract text features manually; the method based on deep learning has not been applied to the case where there are many ambiguous meanings. For the characteristics of Chinese text, the deep Chinese word sense disambiguation method based on sequence to sequence is proposed in this paper. The input is a word context sequence, and the output is a word meaning sequence, which is applicable to all word meaning ambiguity cases. Finally, the method is compared with other seven methods. Test with the data set in the SemEval-2007 Task #5 task. The results show that the test accuracy of the disambiguation is improved by 11.48% compared with the method with the highest accuracy among the seven methods.

articleTitle: Application of Sub-Pixel Image Analysis in Vibration Test of Artillery
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Sensor Networks and Signal Processing (SNSP)
abstract: The characteristic of gun muzzle vibration is an important factor to influence the artillery shot intensity. The conventional test system has non-contact photoelectric test system, laser vibration test system, eddy current displacement sensor test system, etc. However, these testing systems inevitably have some problems.In order to meet the demand of testing the vibration of large caliber gun, a high-speed camera system can be used.At the same time, the DIC sub-pixel displacement algorithm is introduced into the testing process to meet the requirement of precision. The sub-pixel displacement algorithm is much better than the traditional differential displacement algorithm in computing quantity, calculation efficiency and noise resistance. The introduction of sub-pixel algorithm is of great significance to test gun muzzle vibration.

Author Keywords: muzzle vibration, high-speed photography, sub-pixel positioning

articleTitle: Performance Analysis of Large Scale Antenna System Based on Lee Channel
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Sensor Networks and Signal Processing (SNSP)
abstract: With the rapid development of mobile communication technology, in order to solve the problem that the number of antennas is increasing in a large scale, it is difficult to completely arrange and interfere with each other in the limited physical space. This paper is based on the Lee channel model to simulate large-scale MIMO technology. Through simulation, it is found that the channel capacity of the system is linearly related to the signal-to-noise ratio. As the signal-to-noise ratio increases, the channel capacity of the system increases monotonously. The correlation of the system becomes slower as the initial angle decreases, and the overall trend decreases with the increase of antenna number.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of VHDL for High Speed Interleaver in Tactical Data Link
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Sensor Networks and Signal Processing (SNSP)
abstract: This paper introduces the channel coding of data link system, and analyzes the principle and algorithm of interleaved codec in data link. Based on this, a convolutional interleaving codec for RS (204, 188) code is designed and implemented by VHDL. The data delay is realized, and the function of convolutional interleaving is completed. The design has the advantages of simple implementation and low resource consumption.

Author Keywords: data link system, convolutional interleaving, VHDL

articleTitle: Study on Transmission Characteristics of Magnetically Coupled Resonant Radio Power Transmission System
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Sensor Networks and Signal Processing (SNSP)
abstract: Based on the two coil magnetic coupling resonant radio energy transmission structure, a system model is established for the transmission structure by circuit theory, and the expression of the output power and transmission efficiency is derived. The effect of distance, load and resonant frequency on the output power and transmission efficiency of the system is simulated by MATLAB software. The simulation results show that the output power and transmission efficiency are larger when the transmission distance is 0.28 meters, the resonant frequency is 7.32MHz, the load is 10 Omega, and the system can obtain efficient transmission performance at this time. Finally, an experimental prototype is produced, and the experimental results verify the correctness of the theoretical analysis.

articleTitle: The Use of Spectroscopy for Non-destructive Determination of Authenticity of Chinese Calligraphy and Painting
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Sensor Networks and Signal Processing (SNSP)
abstract: Non-contact hyperspectral measuring studies confirm that the destructive ratio of the identified object decreases to ~0%, as well as leading to an improved identification efficiency without affecting the identification accuracy. Therefore, we have explored the material-composition interpretation method of the spectrum curve from hyperspectral data for Chinese calligraphy and painting. The preliminary experiment report a difference between authentic and imitation work in the spectrum curves (for wavelengths from 1000 to 2500 nm) for rice papers and inks. This result is essential for realizing non-destructive high-accuracy identification for Chinese calligraphy and painting.

articleTitle: Design of Chamber Pressure Test System Based on Pressure Bomb
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Sensor Networks and Signal Processing (SNSP)
abstract: Aiming at the chamber pressure dynamic test problem in the environment of high temperature and strong impact, a kind of chamber pressure test system based on pressure bomb is designed. Firstly, the whole structure of test system including data acquisition circuit, signal adjust circuit, data storage circuit and launch module is designed, then applying poly vinylidene fluoride(PVDF) as the pressure sensor to capture the chamber pressure and the test theory of PVDF sensor is analyzed. Lastly, the receiving and sending programs are written according to the nRF24L01 data manual. This method shows that the PVDF bomb can test the chamber pressure effectively which can afford guidance for every kind of gun chamber pressure test and provide basic theory data for capability test of gun.

articleTitle: High Resolution Direction Finding for Nested MIMO Array under Mutual Coupling
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Sensor Networks and Signal Processing (SNSP)
abstract: Due to the superiority in target detection, anti-jamming and parameter estimation of targets, Multiple-input multiple-output (MIMO) radar has attracted wide attention. However, the good performance of direction finding is achieved on the assumption that all the elements of the antenna are in ideal circumstances.
